+"""Durable exact-identity recovery for protected navigation resumes."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Final
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock
+
+import pytest
+from playwright.async_api import Page
+
+from cloud.services.browser_sessions.navigation_resume import NavigationResumeValidation
+from cloud.services.checkpointer import get_run_payload, remember_run_payload
+from cloud.services.checkpointer.navigation import NavigationInterruptContext
+from tests.cloud.browser_routes.interactive_support import (
+    OWNER,
+    REVIEW_CHECKPOINT,
+    RUN_ID,
+    InteractiveHarnessOptions,
+    RecordingOperatorResume,
+    RecordingReconciler,
+    interactive_service_harness,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration
+
+_RESUME_BINDING_KEY: Final = "navigation_resume_binding"
+_BASELINE_SIGNATURE: Final = "signature-before-operator-edit"
+_POST_EDIT_SIGNATURE: Final = "signature-after-operator-edit"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_navigation_lease_persists_exact_binding_before_release(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+) -> None:
+    page = MagicMock(spec=Page)
+    resume = RecordingOperatorResume([])
+    harness = await interactive_service_harness(
+        InteractiveHarnessOptions(
+            viewer_page=page,
+            reconciler=RecordingReconciler([], page_signature=_POST_EDIT_SIGNATURE),
+            resume_operator=resume,
+        )
+    )
+    context = NavigationInterruptContext(
+        run_id=RUN_ID,
+        thread_id="thread-interactive",
+        phase="form_progression",
+        stage="step_ready",
+        reason="no_progress",
+        checkpoint=REVIEW_CHECKPOINT,
+        generation=0,
+        page_signature=_BASELINE_SIGNATURE,
+        takeover_available=True,
+    )
+    record = harness.manager.interrupt_records[RUN_ID]["control"]
+    record.suggested_value = context.to_json()
+    record.interrupt_type = "navigation"
+    remember_run_payload(
+        harness.manager,
+        RUN_ID,
+        context.thread_id,
+        {"existing": "preserved"},
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "cloud.services.browser_sessions.navigation_resume.navigation_step_signature",
+        AsyncMock(return_value=_BASELINE_SIGNATURE),
+    )
+
+    grant = await harness.service.create_interactive_lease(
+        harness.lease_request,
+        process_owner=OWNER,
+    )
+
+    payload = get_run_payload(harness.manager, RUN_ID)
+    assert payload is not None, "protected lease minting must persist run state"
+    assert payload["existing"] == "preserved", (
+        "binding persistence must preserve unrelated run payload fields"
+    )
+    assert payload[_RESUME_BINDING_KEY] == {
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "run_id": RUN_ID,
+        "control_id": "control",
+        "thread_id": context.thread_id,
+        "browser_session_id": str(harness.invocation.access.browser_session_id),
+        "expected_generation": context.generation,
+        "checkpoint": REVIEW_CHECKPOINT,
+        "baseline_page_signature": _BASELINE_SIGNATURE,
+        "stage": "lease_active",
+        "lease_generation": grant.session.generation,
+        "released_generation": None,
+        "post_edit_page_signature": None,
+    }, "the durable binding must identify one interrupt and one retained session"
+    assert resume.validations == [], "lease minting must not resolve the interrupt"
+
+
+def _validation_control_id(
+    validation: NavigationResumeValidation | None,
+) -> str | None:
+    return None if validation is None else validation.control_id
